capabilities.claim: Handshake and session establishment implementations exist in all SDKs.
capabilities.remaining_gap: No shared reference server proves identical real-socket semantics. Tracked by #500 and #501.

capabilities.claim: All SDKs produce and validate the shared canonical signed-envelope representation.
Signatures, freshness, replay and hash-chain checks complete before receive-state commit.
capabilities.remaining_gap: Shared real-wire negative scenarios remain for #501.

capabilities.claim: Post-handshake ping/pong require the negotiated session MAC key before liveness mutation.
Same-session resume preserves receive-chain/replay state; fresh sessions reset the namespace.
capabilities.remaining_gap: Crash/restart and concurrent reconnect fault injection remain for #502.

capabilities.claim: Metadata encryption and routing-tag implementations exist in all SDKs.
capabilities.remaining_gap: No shared four-SDK encrypted-metadata wire scenario exists. Tracked by #501.

capabilities.claim: CI checks shared type definitions across all SDKs.
capabilities.remaining_gap: Type consistency is not behavioral wire interoperability. Tracked by #501.

capabilities.claim: All SDKs execute the same scenarios against an independent reference server.
capabilities.remaining_gap: Reference server #500 and E2E matrix #501 are required.

capabilities.claim: Repository tooling generates and validates a machine-readable conformance report.
capabilities.remaining_gap: This is repository-level tooling, not a native generator in every SDK.

capabilities.claim: The packaged inspector validates canonical traces and emits audit-oriented output.

issue_reconciliation.reason: Source/test capability matrix is now explicit; real-socket interoperability remains.
Positive/negative cryptographic contracts run in mandatory CI.
Mandatory CI runs cross-SDK types, canonical contracts, native suites and conformance validation without secrets.

open_gaps: #500 independent reference server and deterministic E2E harness
#502 deterministic fault, reconnect race and crash/restart testing
